heraliz_tactique.vitres.verre: Glass for HeraliZ (glass, stained or tinted glass, pane).
heraliz_tactique.vitres.en_plus_casse: Block from blocs_en_plus: a bullet turns it into %s, it turns back after the delay.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.en_plus: Block from blocs_en_plus: a bullet removes it, it comes back after the delay.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.pas_vitre: Not a window for HeraliZ: it never breaks. What breaks: glass, panes and the blocks in blocs_en_plus ([vitres] in heralisz_tactical-server.toml).
heraliz_tactique.vitres.casse: It breaks under bullets here and comes back after %s min.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.attente: Waiting to grow back for %s min: %s comes back here in %s min, if the spot is free.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.balle_traverse: A bullet fired from here goes through it without hitting it (PassThroughBlocks in tacz-common.toml or tag tacz:bullet_ignore).
heraliz_tactique.vitres.balle_touche: A bullet fired from here does hit it.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.balle_avant: A bullet fired from here first stops on %s at %s.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.crochet: The HeraliZ hook in TaCZ bullet paths does not respond (TaCZ changed?): blocks that bullets go through (full glass, furniture windows) do not break.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.eau: Waterlogged window: it does not break (the water would spread). Place it again without water so it breaks.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.protege: Block in the blocs_proteges list: it never breaks.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.dimension: Protected dimension (%s, dimensions_protegees): nothing breaks there.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.spawn: %s blocks from the world spawn point (%s): within the rayon_spawn of %s blocks, nothing breaks.
heraliz_tactique.vitres.claim: Inside a CRac claim (claim block at %s): nothing breaks there (proteger_claims_crac).
heraliz_tactique.a_vie.texte: Lifetime item: on the ground, anyone can take it.
heraliz_tactique.a_vie.touche: Lifetime item: it can't be dropped with the drop key.
